commit_note: HW2 submission: FastAPI CRUD, LangGraph supervisor pattern, schema validation experiments

checks.name: fastapi_responds_on_port_base
checks.description: GET / on PORT_BASE (8817) returns HTTP 200, serving code/web_application/HW2-RachandeepKaur.html
checks.evidence: Verified via curl (HTTP 200) and Playwright page load during CRUD UI testing

checks.name: add_record_endpoint
checks.description: POST /api/records creates a new record from the existing inspection form's primary+secondary fields and returns 201 Created with the new record (JSON API, not a redirect)
checks.evidence: Verified via curl and a headless-browser run: submitting the form added a new row to the records table

checks.name: update_record_by_id
checks.description: PUT /api/records/{record_id} updates the named record's facility_name and returns 200 with the updated record; a nonexistent id returns 404
checks.evidence: Verified via curl (id=2 -> 200, id=99 -> 404) and a headless-browser run updating record 1 by ID

checks.name: delete_highest_id
checks.description: DELETE /api/records/highest removes the record with the highest id and returns it
checks.evidence: Verified via curl and a headless-browser run (table row count decreased, correct row removed)

checks.name: search_functionality
checks.description: Client-side search filters the records table to rows whose facility_name or site_address contains the query (case-insensitive substring)
checks.evidence: Verified via a headless-browser run: query matched only the intended row, Clear restored the full list

checks.name: langgraph_terminates
checks.description: Graph invocation completes (does not hang) within the turn ceiling on both normal and adversarial inputs
checks.evidence: Dozens of real runs across reports/hw02/raw/schema_validation_runs.json (30), raw/turn_ceiling_runs.json (40), and the in-progress adversarial run - every run terminated, none hung

checks.name: planner_output_schema
checks.description: PlannerOutput enforces exactly 3 tags (each 3-30 chars) and a <=25-word summary via Pydantic (Field constraints + a field_validator), not just prompt text
checks.evidence: code/tests/test_planner_validation.py: 6/6 deterministic cases (1 valid, 5 invalid) behaved as expected

checks.name: validation_retry_feedback
checks.description: A Planner schema-validation failure (caught ModelClientError) is fed back into the next Planner attempt via reviewer_feedback and retried, bounded by MAX_TURNS - does not crash the graph
checks.evidence: code/tests/test_planner_validation_retry.py (stub client, both a recovering case and an always-failing case bounded at MAX_TURNS); real confirmation in the adversarial run log (multiple 'FAILED VALIDATION' retries per run, graph still terminates)

checks.name: turn_ceiling_respected
checks.description: Graph never exceeds the configured MAX_TURNS, on both a forced-rejection run and the turn-ceiling comparison experiment
checks.evidence: raw/turn_ceiling_runs.json: all 20 ceiling=2 runs stopped at exactly turn_count=2; adversarial run 1 stopped at exactly turn_count=8 (MAX_TURNS=8) - never exceeded in any observed run

checks.name: frozen_input_classification_30x
checks.description: Fixed input (cases/schema_input.json) run 30x through the graph, each run classified by Planner schema-validation retry count
checks.evidence: raw/schema_validation_runs.json (30 real records) + METRICS.md outcome table: 30/30 valid_first_attempt, mean latency 26314.1 ms

checks.name: turn_ceiling_comparison_20x_each
checks.description: Same fixed input run 20x each at MAX_TURNS=2 and MAX_TURNS=10, completion rate + mean latency reported, one ceiling picked and justified
checks.evidence: raw/turn_ceiling_runs.json (40 real records) + TURN_CEILING.md: ceiling=2 -> 0/20 (0.0%, structurally impossible - cap trips before the Reviewer ever runs), ceiling=10 -> 20/20 (100.0%); MAX_TURNS=10 recommended

checks.name: adversarial_case_5x
checks.description: One adversarial input (cases/adversarial_input.json: fact-dense summary + a task field demanding exhaustive detail, conflicting with the hard <=25-word/3-tag constraints) run 5x, ceiling-hit rate reported honestly
checks.evidence: raw/adversarial_runs.json (5 real records) + ADVERSARIAL_CASE.md: ceiling hit in 5/5 runs (100%, exceeding the ideal >=4/5 target), all stopped at exactly turn_count=8, mean latency 404904.6 ms (min 225792 ms, max 977581 ms)
